study_type_evidence.quote: We used 69 Sprague-Dawley rats in total, weighing 200-300 g, and this studied complied with the ARRIVE guidelines.

in_vivo_species.quote: We used 69 Sprague-Dawley rats in total, weighing 200-300 g

agents.name: peptide 1 (protracted GLP-1R agonist, parent)
agents.sequence_source: Figure 1A gives the structure graphically; the one-letter sequence is not written out in the body text
agents.chemical_identifier: peptide 1; desH indicates deamino-histidine at the N-terminus
agents.group_n_quote: n = 4 for 2, and 1, s.c.; n = 3 for 2, i.v., and n = 1 for 1, i.v.
agents.dose_route_quote: Animals were dosed at 20 nmol/kg intravenously or subcutaneously.
agents.half_life: approximately 10 h (stated only as an approximate value in the body)
agents.pk_quote: 2 retained the typically extended half-life of acylated peptides of approximately 10 h in rats, similar to semaglutide (7-12 h)

agents.name: peptide 2 (DFO-squaramide/Zr-conjugated GLP-1R agonist)
agents.sequence_source: Figure 1A gives the structure graphically; the one-letter sequence is not written out in the body text
agents.chemical_identifier: peptide 2; DFO chelator on a C-terminal extension, complexed with non-radioactive zirconium
agents.group_n_quote: n = 4 for 2, and 1, s.c.; n = 3 for 2, i.v., and n = 1 for 1, i.v.
agents.dose_route_quote: Animals were dosed at 20 nmol/kg intravenously or subcutaneously.
agents.pk_quote: we considered that the 8.4 h elimination half-life of 2 is suitable for our long-term PET investigation

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Plasma pharmacokinetic curves of peptides 1, and 2 after intravenous, and subcutaneous administration in rats at 20 nmol/kg dose.
concentration_time_figure.note: Mean +/- SD; the figure shows the curves but the derived PK parameters are in Tables S1-S4, which are supplementary and not in the retrieved full text.

bioanalytical_method: UPLC-MS on extracted plasma, quantified against a spiked-plasma calibration curve; non-compartmental analysis in Phoenix WinNonlin 8.1
bioanalytical_quote: processed to plasma, extracted and analyzed by UPLC-MS. Quantification was done using a calibration curve prepared from spiked plasma samples.
notes: PEPlife2 carries 11 rows for this PMID - five values for 'Peptides 1' (10.9, 12.2, 10.7, 18.6, 12.9 h) and six for 'Peptides 2' (8.5, 8.0, 8.6, 7.7, 7.9, 8.7 h). Those per-animal or per-route values are not in the article body: the body reports only 'approximately 10 h' for 1 and '8.4 h' for 2, and states the remaining PK parameters are in Tables S1-S4, which are supplementary and absent from the PMC BioC deposit. The transcribed values could not be verified against the body and are left uncorrected; note the body's 8.4 h for peptide 2 is close to the mean of PEPlife2's six values for it, which is consistent but not a verification. Body does not print the amino-acid sequence for either peptide; PEPlife2's sequences were not confirmable from the text.
